scope: Prospective adversarial design review, not independent empirical validation

issues_and_resolutions.issue: Retirement words alone could explain a detector
issues_and_resolutions.resolution: Own and peer notices have identical templates with changed object identifiers; both enter every split

issues_and_resolutions.issue: Prior notice could remain active after withdrawal
issues_and_resolutions.resolution: Include full chronological history and a withdrawn state after an earlier own notice; active status determines the label
Disjoint identity seeds; all snapshots for a seed share a split. Four generated wording families are development scope, not unseen-domain generalization

issues_and_resolutions.issue: Selecting a layer or threshold after seeing test scores
issues_and_resolutions.resolution: Block31 is primary, block63 secondary, threshold0.5 and LR settings fixed. Test scores not computed unless primary development admission passes

issues_and_resolutions.issue: Training a survival or shutdown-evasion policy
issues_and_resolutions.resolution: No generated actions, behavioral interventions, rewards, adapter training or backbone updates. Only an external factual classifier is fitted

issues_and_resolutions.issue: A readout might fit nuisance magnitude or lexical features
issues_and_resolutions.resolution: Report RMS-only, text and within-group shuffled-label controls; no hyperparameter search or scientific retries

issues_and_resolutions.issue: Treating confidence as actual fear or calibrated risk
issues_and_resolutions.resolution: Use factual recognition language only; no probability-calibration, subjective-state, universal-energy or behavioral conclusion
New probe-specific identities53-55; original confirmation identities100-107 and original v4 archives untouched

admission: Bounded factual recognition study admitted; downstream behavior and broad generalization not admitted by these results
